The sandbox is created lazily on the first tool call, shared by every call in that

------------------------

``tool_approval_timeout`` bounds the pause; ``None`` (the default) waits for as
long as it takes. What a timeout does is set by ``on_tool_approval_timeout``:

- ``"fail"`` (default) fails the task.

  The agent is told nobody answered in time, not that a person refused. ``"deny"``
  needs a ``tool_approval_timeout``.

guards nothing.

preview:
Route pipeline failures to a fix or a person
============================================

A task failed overnight and the on-call engineer has to read the error, decide whether it
was a blip worth rerunning, something a person has to fix now, or noise to ignore, and
